gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Righteous bends line-filling bowls from what looks like thin steel rod, with no pinched joints or flared ends. Noto Sans Old Persian lets paragraphs breathe, its open counters welcoming white space.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: A wire-like monoline skeleton gives Righteous its bent-rod look, bowls filling the line edge to edge. Noto Sans Old Sogdian does the quieter job in plain sans, with a tall x-height, wide mouths staying crisp when shrunk.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic reads chunky and clear, its open-mouthed curves never clogging. And Righteous, with no thick-thin modulation, handles the loud entrance while that plain sans carries the words.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Righteous holds its thickness constant whatever direction a stroke travels, like thin steel rod bent into bowls. Noto Sans Oriya joins in with generous curve gaps, so the bent-rod heading sits over text that stays open.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-osage: Inflated bowls, bent-pipe strokes: Righteous fills every line with curves of constant width. Noto Sans Osage carries that roundness into the text, its sweeping curves never closing up.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya gives its s shapes wide, easy turns and makes lowercase look oversized beside the capitals. Righteous glides above it like wire, and the text follows easily.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Righteous fills the line with bowls of bent steel rod. It handles the loud entrance, while Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, with its high-set x-height, does the steady text work.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: A technical-pen line weight defines Righteous, its bowls filling the line. Noto Sans Palmyrene, a sans-serif with curves that stop short and compressed ascenders, reads cleanly across whole paragraphs.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau reads clean and modern beneath Righteous, its open-ended curves leaving room to breathe. And over many lines, that sans stays easy on the eye, its capitals only a short step above lowercase.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Text reads with see-through c openings and a gentle bump up to capitals, under Righteous and its unvarying line. Noto Sans PhagsPa keeps a contemporary, approachable feel, a sans-serif content to stay out of the way.
